newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Valora to float Selecta division.
newsitem.headline: Valora to float Selecta division.

text.p: Valora Holding AG said it planned to float its vending machine division Selecta on the stock exchange.

The company also said its board has decided that part of the funds raised by the sale should go directly to shareholders. Accordingly, it will propose a reduction in the nominal value of Valora shares at the June 25 general meeting.
Valora said it intends to offer 60 percent of Selecta's shares to the public. Valora and Compass Group Plc will each hold a 20 percent stake in Selecta.

It said the planned flotation will create the conditions for Selecta to open up new geographic markets more quickly, by means of joint venture for example, without needing to take overriding group interests into account.
Selecta generates annual sales of 640 million Swiss francs and has 2,800 employees.
Separately, Valora said Reto Hartmann, manager of its kiosk division, will take over from Fritz Frohofer as chief executive of the group as of the general meeting on June 24, 1998.
